slides.headline: Kimberly Guilfoyle faces conduct allegations in Athens
slides.body: AP says the reports involve alleged improper conduct before and during Kimberly Guilfoyle’s tenure as U.S. ambassador to Greece.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons United States Embassy Athens Greece American flag
photo.prompt: close dramatic view of the U.S. Embassy in Athens with the American flag in front and security fencing visible

slides.headline: Trump and Rubio are weighing firing her
slides.body: AP says President Donald Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio are considering firing Guilfoyle after mounting reports of improper conduct.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons Harry S Truman Building State Department Washington DC exterior flags
photo.prompt: dramatic exterior of the U.S. State Department building in Washington with flags under a cloudy sky

slides.headline: Rubio declined to comment on Oct. 9
slides.body: A report on Oct. 9 said Rubio refused to comment on the allegations before the AP story on Oct. 11.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons United States Department of State building entrance Washington DC
photo.prompt: tight photo of the State Department entrance in Washington with official signage and flags

slides.headline: The New York Times reported backlash in Greece
slides.body: The New York Times reported exasperation and resignation in Greece over the allegations on Oct. 10.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons Athens Greece Acropolis night city view
photo.prompt: wide nighttime view of Athens with the Acropolis lit above the city and government buildings below

slides.headline: The decision is still under review
slides.body: AP says the firing decision is under review, so Guilfoyle’s future in Athens is still uncertain.
